test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the National Multidimensional poverty index 2021, which of the following states has the lowest percentage of population being multidimensional poor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Approximately **3.82% of the population** in Sikkim lives in multidimensional poverty
 
• The National MPI is calculated using three dimensions:** health, education, and living standards.**
 
• The National MPI 2021 revealed a reduction in multidimensional poverty by **9.89%**.
 
• **NITI Aayog** launches the National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) in India.
 
• The index uses data from the **National Family Health Survey (NFHS)**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Approximately 51.91%** of the population in **Bihar** lives in multidimensional poverty.
 
• **Approximately 5.59% **of the population in **Punjab** lives in multidimensional poverty.
 
• **Approximately 14.85%** of the population in **Maharashtra** lives in multidimensional poverty.
 
• Of these, **1.3 billion people (21.7%) **are recognized as living in multidimensional poverty.
